<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#07111f" />
  <meta name="description" content="NextRace — corrida, força e próxima prova em um único ciclo." />
  <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest" />
  <link rel="icon" href="icons/icon-192.png" />
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icons/icon-192.png" />
  <title>NextRace</title>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="appShell" class="app-shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="brand-wrap">
        <div class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">NR</div>
        <div>
          <div class="brand">NextRace</div>
          <div class="subtitle">treine para o que vem depois</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button id="installBtn" class="btn ghost compact hidden" type="button">Instalar</button>
    </header>

    <main id="view" class="view" aria-live="polite"></main>

    <nav class="bottom-nav" aria-label="Navegação principal">
      <button class="nav-item active" data-route="home" type="button"><span>⌂</span><small>Hoje</small></button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-route="plan" type="button"><span>▦</span><small>Plano</small></button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-route="progress" type="button"><span>↗</span><small>Evolução</small></button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-route="races" type="button"><span>⚑</span><small>Provas</small></button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-route="profile" type="button"><span>◎</span><small>Perfil</small></button>
    </nav>
  </div>

  <dialog id="workoutDialog" class="modal"></dialog>
  <dialog id="raceDialog" class="modal"></dialog>
  <input id="importInput" class="hidden" type="file" accept="application/json" />

  <script>
  async function inflate64(b64){
    const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(b64),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
    const stream=new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
    return await new Response(stream).text();
  }
